blocks.html: WinTAK shows you and everyone in your group on one shared map — this is blue force tracking. Here's how to read the map, see your group, and set your own position when your PC has no GPS.

slides.title: Starting position
slides.html: If your PC has no GPS, WinTAK starts at the 0/0 coordinates. You'll move the map to your area and set your position manually.

slides.title: Move and zoom the map
slides.html:
Move the map with the mouse toward Finland.

  • Zoom with the mouse wheel, the plus/minus keys, or the on-screen buttons.

slides.title: Straighten the map
slides.html: Click the compass icon (N) to straighten the map to north-up.

slides.title: See your group
slides.html: Other users in your group appear as coloured icons. Each icon's colour is the colour that user set for themselves.

slides.title: Set your location manually
slides.html: If your device has no GPS, set your own location: press the red information field in the bottom-right corner.

slides.title: Pick your position
slides.html: Find your location on the map and click it. Your own marker then appears — and becomes visible to other users.

slides.title: Change your location
slides.html: To move yourself later, click your own marker (the arrow symbol), then click a new location.
